cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. For your sister's wedding, should I book us one room or two?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Double bed, then, or shall I ask for twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait for you in the lobby?

mechanism: A approves practical wedding arrangements while forcing each approved detail to reveal B view of their relationship indirectly.
confusable: D76 asks blessing for a known relationship; D78 probes what the relationship is without asking its label.
comparison: Public family breakfast placement differs from private towel belonging and future visits.
seedUse: Use D78-a room, beds and breakfast progression; let B requests become approvals with revealing follow-up questions.
